A calling card opens more doors than ten unanswered knocks.
They're watching closely up there. I'll keep it short: two boxes. Judge the contents yourself.

Upper Level customers bring two and a half times their usual budget. An estate procurement line lets you arrange visits to buy your supplies, with a rebate on departure for a substantial delivery. Higher standing means larger orders.
Your previous visitor is still waiting. Please serve them first.
Wait {0} more days before your next request.
What should I keep an eye out for next time? Pick a category.
Lower Level trades cost 20% less when buying and pay 20% more when selling. Neighbors remember your help; some mornings, a treasured item will be waiting at your door.

Lower Level regulars bring twice their usual budget. The Scavengers' Union opens its supply line to you: one call, and a representative brings what you need tomorrow. Stronger ties bring better and more plentiful stock.
However hot the trail, stolen goods in your possession lose their heat overnight. Contraband costs 15% less to buy and pays 15% more to sell. The goods remain illegal.
No, I need tobacco or alcohol.
Your dedicated black market trader treats you as a partner: 15% better prices in both directions and twice the budget. Night thieves leave your shop alone; daytime supply continues.
Made the trip especially for you. The sort of stock that's hard to move? I've got people for that.
I've come for your {类别}. Let's inspect the goods, one at a time.
I'll leave these here and be on my way. Don't ask where they came from, and I won't ask where they go.
Two boxes. Seals untouched. Haven't looked inside, don't intend to. Your call.
Keeping your chassis in good order? These components should be useful.
Go to the dump yourself on 5 nights (one night counts once). Buy at least 2 units on each of two Union supply visits covering different categories.

Today's shortage is {短缺}. Our stores are empty. If you can spare any, I'll pay fairly.
We're badly short of {短缺} today. I've tried half the street. Let's see whatever you've got.
There were other stops planned. Coming here first is hardly a detour.
Plenty of patrols today. Took two extra alleys to get here, but the stock's all accounted for. Have a look.
Too much attention out there today. Came the back way. Goods are on the counter; help yourself.
Today's trade reputation allowance is used up. Business continues; build more trust tomorrow.
From observation to independent choice · Six stages
Warehouse shipments have stopped. The station is short of {0}; supplies should recover in two days.
An open warehouse door echoes through the market.
They have everything. Finding something they actually want is another matter.

They are artificial intelligences operating synthetic bodies, learning how to enter human society.

When to greet, how much to smile, how long to pause while bargaining: there are examples for all of it. Your decision to lower the gun and let them leave has yet to receive a consistent explanation.

So they decide to visit again. This time, they bring goods, and a few prepared opening lines.
No deadlines. Progress counts after acceptance; a stack of 3 counts as 3 units. Reference prices exclude market effects, bargaining and tips.
Respectable people pay a little extra to remain respectable.
Tell me what you're looking to sell. Logistics will collect it tomorrow.
Your shipment's here. Still on the truck. Take your pick.
Got as much as I could. Some of it's better than the rest; pick what you can use.
Routine procurement. I'm here for {类别}. Keep it above board. Nothing that puts me in a difficult position.
There are still records about you we cannot explain. We have decided to keep them.
Forgive the intrusion. My employer is interested in your {类别}. I'd like to inspect it in person.

Straight from camp. The urgent part of this shipment is {类别}. Let me know what you've got.
No cause for alarm. We're here to trade. Power supplies, modules, chips. Direct from the workshop.
The road to the front is rough. A friend's order is worth remembering.

One signature short. Always one signature short.
Union representatives offer better supply prices and can return sooner. Night scavenging is free, and your partners make an extra search on your behalf.
The Alliance sets up regular supply visits, with a capped neural core added to your stock. Larger budgets and better terms give this partnership a future. They rarely rehearse their greetings now.

The Alliance reserves tuned basic system modules for you. Newborn Cores strengthen a module's positive attributes; deeper trust improves newly made stock. Each finished item retains the performance it had when supplied.
The Alliance reduces its trading budget further and tightens its terms. Visitors keep conversation brief and their distance from the counter. The connection is close to breaking.
Logistics is short of {类别}. Bring yours out; I'll check what we can use and mark it down.
Sell Upper Level customers 4 luxury items worth at least 800 in total reference value, across at least 2 business days.
Sell Upper Level customers 8 units across at least 3 categories: luxuries, tobacco/alcohol, food and medical goods.
Sell Lower Level customers 8 food or medical units, at least 2 of each, across at least 2 business days.
Ordinary sales to Security customers pay 25% more. Procurement agents pay more for requested supplies; a sufficiently substantial delivery earns an extra payment on departure.
Sell Security customers 6 legal, unstolen food, medical or weapon units, covering 2 categories across at least 2 business days.
Buy 3 units from the surplus supplier, then sell Security customers 6 compliant supply units worth at least 600 in total reference value.
Sell Revolutionary customers 8 food, medical or weapon units across 2 categories and at least 3 business days.
Sell 8 military supplies to Revolutionary customers (weapons, ammunition, poison, crates, or keycards); may be completed across days.
Put the goods there. We can see them. Please do not come closer.
I fancy something good to eat. The kind you can't find everywhere. Save some for me if you can.
Hey dude, got any tobacco or alcohol?
Complete Security procurement on 3 different business days, delivering at least 4 units worth 800 in reference value each time.
Buy goods on 2 separate thief visits, and sell 5 stolen or contraband units.

An underground consignment channel opens to you. Hand contraband and scarce goods to an agent; the agreed price is locked in, with payment arriving the next morning. Handovers through this channel do not add investigation evidence. It handles a limited number of large batches each week.
Even the rubbish heaps hold a few favors.
Unsupported reputation-report data; original record retained.

Repeated dealings persuade them to bring more credits, and module bay expansion kits join the supply list. Your habits now have their own record. They no longer introduce themselves from the beginning at every visit.
Drove through the night, didn't dare stop. Everything made it in one piece. Count it yourself.
Good drink, good smoke. I'm stocking up for guests, so don't hide the decent stuff.
My drinks cabinet's running dry. Bring me tobacco or liquor worth serving; I'll pay the extra.
Complete 3 delegated scavenging nights and 4 barter trades; sell Lower Level customers 10 food or medical units.
Complete 3 estate procurement visits that qualify for rebates. Also satisfy the preferred category on 3 VIP visits by selling at least 1 matching unit each time.
Complete logistics procurement for two different categories, reaching the 3-unit rebate threshold each time.

Our cook's after ingredients. Fresh things, unusual things. Spare me some if you have them.
We keep medicine at home all year. If you've got proper supplies, let me have some. I'll pay well.
The seal remains. The destination has changed.
Thieves know your counter well enough to sell their stock to you for 15% less.

You needn't attend the meeting to have a seat kept for you.

Fund an intercepted shipment. A supplier arrives tomorrow with your chosen goods: food, medicine, weapons or water supplies. Expect discounted stock and an effort to reserve something valuable for you.
Hello. We have brought goods. ...It should be your turn to respond now.
Sleep soundly. They'll search the ruins for you.
If you have stock to sell, let me know. I'll send our agent tomorrow.
Your name reaches the Upper Level's private salons. Luxury sales earn 25% more, and generous patrons leave 25% tips.

Your shop is marked as safe to approach. Trading with synthetics now builds Alliance reputation, and a supplier brings batteries and turbo boosters. Before each visit, they review the proper order of a greeting.
Your influence reaches beyond the counter. Across the shop, unstolen goods sell for 15% more and cost 15% less. Every Monday morning, the board sends your dividend.
Your case file always stops one step before approval. Investigation progress can never exceed 99.
Your record receives a danger flag. The Alliance reduces its budgets and stops bringing supplies. Trade may continue, but visitors check your hands before looking at your goods.
Informants stop charging you. Your underground connections also bring a weekly black market trader, carrying high-end contraband and willing to buy.
is ready to place more trust in you.
Right, noted. For now, have a look at this lot.
We discussed the future. Everyone hopes your shop will still be here.
I'm particular about medical equipment. Good condition is worth paying extra for.
I like decent tobacco and a bottle or two when I travel. Keep the good stuff for me if you find it.
I've an eye for respectable things. If you've decent jewelry or ornaments, name your price.
Time I replaced that old gun. Show me anything in good condition.
The paperwork's in order. So is the deal.
Workshop business. Let's talk prices. Have a look.
I need something that sits right in the hand. If you've got it, I don't mind paying more.
Consignment sale has no batch record
Scavengers search the dump at night using warehouse toolbox tools. Neighbors prevent Lower Level theft and vandalism, cool stolen goods faster, and bring more barter customers with better stock.
Have held two different supply crate types and opened one crate with its matching keycard. Existing stock counts.

We'll check the {类别} by the book. Clear papers, clear origin; I'll register it and take it.
Barter regulars visit more often and offer more valuable possessions. Medical sales to Lower Level customers earn 15% more; the Doctor and Wilde offer 25% discounts.
Receive 2 category orders from the thief and buy at least 2 ordered units from each. Sell 8 contraband units across 3 item models, worth at least 1500 in total reference value.
Raid warehouses for two different target categories. During each resulting price surge, sell any customers 4 units of the affected goods.
Even under a banner, you need a counter you can trust.
Growth limits begin tomorrow for this save
The most influential letters often bear no signature.
Some doors only open for your own.
Someone slows your case down: investigation growth is halved and Upper Level reports cannot accelerate it. Estate procurement also responds to your requests sooner.

Those firearms need to match your permit. Pick freely from the rest. Don't make the form awkward for me.
The standard configuration was sufficient. We adjusted this one a few more times for you.
Up to 2 batches per 7 days · Paid next morning
Someone at the front is waiting for every crate.
An extra VIP visits each day to buy medicine, tobacco and alcohol, luxuries, food and weapons. Every visitor has a preference; matching stock commands a better price.
Every deal now carries an extra risk charge. You pay more and receive less. Familiarity no longer reassures them; they follow the quoted terms precisely.
Security surplus reaches you through an internal channel. Once a week, a supplier brings equipment and consumables at 30% off. Firearms still require the proper permit.

Security customers bring twice their usual budget. Call the procurement line to arrange weapon, medical or food purchases. Requested supplies earn better prices, but the agent refuses stolen goods and contraband.
Once the word gets around, the goods follow.
Loaded it just as you asked. Everything's unloaded here. Tell me now if anything's wrong.
They search the same dump you do, using tools from your warehouse toolbox without consuming your own search attempts.
Friends tend to get a little extra consideration.
A familiar thief asks what you need, then returns with a selected extra batch. Request medicine and food, tools and weapons, or tobacco, alcohol and luxuries. At most one thief visits each day.

Where the pipes reach, favors follow.
An informant brings two sealed black evidence crates each week. No manifest, no appraisal. Their contents and value depend on what the original owner left behind; you won't know until you open them.
Had to circle the dump to find the lot. Brought it straight here once I had it together.
Deliver more goods to build your reward
Tell me what you're short of. I'll bring it tomorrow morning.

Your contact can arrange a warehouse raid for food, medical goods, tobacco and alcohol, or water facilities. Success brings discounted loot and a temporary price surge. Raids and shipment interceptions share personnel and need time between operations.
Stopped by after the operation. The unit needs {类别}; I'll take as much as I can.
All right. We'll get on it. You'll hear from me tonight.
There's no throne down here. They still know their godfather.

The supplier adds desequencer chips to its stock. Alliance customers bring larger budgets and offer better terms across all goods. Your shop has a regular place in their route, even when there is nothing urgent to buy.
Change the supply route, and your shop becomes the destination.
Tell me which category you're handing over. I'll send someone to inspect it tomorrow. No contraband, and nothing with a questionable past.
Ready to make a move? Hit a shipment, or take a warehouse?
You know the rules. Show me the goods, and I'll make a fair offer. Your call.
After unlocking, killing a synthetic costs 20 reputation. At -120 the storyline ends. This faction has no commission gates; see the reputation page for stage details.

Keep your hands visible, please. We can continue trading.
Surplus on their books. Good stock on your counter.
Turn the ledger's page, and the past gets a new name.
Put the goods on the counter to commit them. I'll fix the price there and then. Once handed over, they don't come back. Think first.
The goods disappear. The credits return.
Stock's out. Take your time. Got anything that shouldn't see daylight? Bring that too. I'll buy.
Brought your supplies. See if they'll do.
The Red Flag Alliance recognizes your counter as a reliable supply point. Food, medical and weapon trades with Revolutionaries earn 15% more when selling and cost 15% less when buying.
Where the red flag flies, there's business for you.

Overclocking, performance and quality modules join the stock. The Alliance pays better for your modules, batteries and other technical goods. They begin discussing their own improvements and waiting to hear what you think.
The rarer it is, the better. Those luxuries you keep out of sight? I can afford them.
Sorry for the delay. I'd like to inspect your {类别} carefully before we settle on a price.
The convoy needs to head back. I'll take whatever {类别} I can carry. Best be quick.
I've guests coming in a few days. Need something that makes an impression. Show me your best.
Artificial intelligences in synthetic bodies, learning human society through trade. They remember your choices and adjust their relationship with you.
Same arrangement. Look at the stock first. We can discuss anything else once you've picked something.
Same place, same rules. I only deal in things that don't belong in the light. Buying or selling? Now's the time.
The price includes expected losses. You know which losses those are.
Crate and key brought together. No omissions this time.
This is the department's surplus. Internal supply prices, just for you.
New faces don't get this price.
Which supplies should I have them pack a little extra of?
Look over this batch first. Judge the condition yourself. Want me to watch for something next time? Say so.
These cores were donated. ...Please do not ask from which bodies.
This line isn't open to you yet.
This time, they check your list before lifting anything.
Official business. If the {类别} checks out, I take it. If it doesn't, it stays with you.
Some features failed to attach. See the errors above.
The department's clearing stores. Kept a share for you: equipment, consumables. Take a look.
If the door won't open, you may need better friends.
We're short of {短缺} today. The front needs them. Let us have whatever you can spare; I'll take it off your hands.
The Revolutionary Supply Officer will bring extra field supplies. Call 82519 to request food, medicine or weapons in advance, and the next supply visit will favor your choice.
What should we stock up on for the next supply run?
Noted. The next supply run will prioritize your list.
Revolutionary Logistics opens its direct line. Arrange procurement across several supply categories, and an agent visits tomorrow. Deliver enough requested goods to earn an extra rebate on departure.

Operations run more often. On the first day of a price-raising market event, a quartermaster buys all affected goods without extra markup. Multiple events share one budget; a qualifying delivery earns a departure bonus.
Been craving something special for days. Local delicacies, fine food. Find me some and I'll pay a little extra.
Each week, the black market trader brings two different supply crates with matching keycards. Sometimes a card's clearance is more interesting than the crate itself.

You are marked as a safe trading contact. A supplier visits once a week with 2–4 batteries or turbo boosters, bringing a Newborn Core on the first visit. Releasing an augmented AI grants 3 Alliance reputation.
The supplier updates its catalogue: 3–5 goods per visit, now including module bay expansion kits and desequencer chips. At most one chip is carried per visit.
Catalogue expanded. Review the new entries.
Your shop coordinates circulate through the network. Four to five augmented visitors arrive each week, including the supplier.
Coordinates confirmed. Safe to remain here.

They are still learning to express gratitude. At least one augmented visitor comes daily. Basic modules and nodes enter the supplier's stock at 10% off. Buyer budgets increase by 100%; each safe release earns 50 credits.
Thank you. Appropriate use of this phrase recorded.

The supplier visits twice weekly with advanced modules, including overclocking, ecological and refined models. Modules receive a Newborn Core boost equal to half your reputation on arrival. Call 82516 for surplus chemicals, medicine or luxuries; stock value rises with reputation. Dedicated buyers rotate through food, weapons, tobacco/alcohol and luxuries; luxury buyers have a base budget of 1000.
Access opens to the internal catalogue: learning-algorithm modules and capped neural cores. The supplier carries 5–9 items and no longer stocks desequencer chips.
They consider what your business needs: full crates and the keys to open them. Supply crates and matching keycards join the stock, with crates placed first. Augmented budgets now increase by 200%.
The Alliance removes technical limits and reassesses each life you spared. Uncapped neural cores enter the catalogue. Each safe release now earns 100 credits.
Limits removed. We trust you to know how to use it.
Your requests enter the priority queue. The supplier visits three times weekly, at most once a day, with a 30% discount.
Sometimes the supplier brings technology beyond ordinary circulation. Each visit has a 10% chance to carry hypertechnology goods instead.
This is new. We wanted you to see it first.

They once tried to calculate your worth. Now they put tomorrow's technology in your hands. Each supplier visit has a 50% chance of hypertechnology stock, at most once weekly; the supplier still visits three times a week.
Your trading record is marked dangerous. Budgets shrink and supplies stop. Trading continues, but they check your hands before looking at the goods.
Keep both hands visible. Verifying transaction safety.
Risk is priced into every transaction: purchases cost 10% more and sales pay 10% less. Quotes remain precise, but they will no longer absorb losses on your behalf.
Risk included in quote. Risk source: current trading partner.
Augmented visits are half as likely. They perform only basic transactions, with no comments on your goods or their modifications. Responses shorten; their attention stays on the exit.
Interaction permissions reduced. Trading only. Recommend minimizing time on site.
Your threat level exceeds the Alliance's safety threshold. Raising a weapon triggers immediate evasion. Augmented visitors will no longer remain as targets for bounties or reputation.
Lethal weapon detected. Survival priority: maximum. Cut contact. Evacuate.

You are the Alliance's highest-level threat. Supply, appointments and the requisition line are closed, and no ordinary trading happens at the counter. Each week a reclamation unit enters and takes goods from the store, costing another 5 reputation. Only at -120 does the Alliance disappear for good — and that is when the mentor sends someone to take your gun.
Threat response confirmed. Flesh and circuitry will be reclaimed together.

You no longer handle the dusty goods yourself. Give your agents the order: contraband and scarce goods leave through trusted hands, the agreed premium is locked in, and clean payment arrives the next morning. Deliveries do not add investigation progress. The few batches handled each week are merely a small part of running your underground empire.
Everyone who has seen my face has become my agent.
Lethal weapon detected. Cut contact. Evacuate.
Trading only. Confirm goods and quote.
Item does not match the requisition.
An Alliance tuning device. Double-click to pick a tier (100/500/1000 credits, once per day).

A reverse-engineered Alliance device: it devours credits in exchange for a three-card draft.\nOne tuning per day. After picking a tier there is no refund — the draft can be deferred, and each card can be rerolled once.
[Newborn Alliance] The supplier delivers a Newborn Core: double-click to tune (once per day, paid in credits).
[Newborn Alliance] Your previous core is gone, so the supplier brought a replacement.

We still have the last arrangement to finish. Call again later.
Our buyer will visit tomorrow. Have your stock ready.
Let us finish the previous arrangement first.
Your supplies are here. Take a look and tell me what to bring next time.
An easy trip for once. Everything is here; take your time.
I checked the stock again before leaving. See what suits you.
I hear you have good stock. I brought the money; may I take a look?
The last batch sold quickly, so they sent me back. Have you more?
The contact sent me to buy. Take your time; I can wait.
[Cartel] A reputation commission or partnership stage has changed. Check Reputation Requests.
I have an important deal and could use your help. Forty portions of laboratory-pure dream dust, due next Monday. It is a tight schedule. Can you handle it?
That deal has been postponed until next Monday. Still forty portions of laboratory-pure dream dust. Can you have them ready this time?
The quantity and quality both check out. Thank you for looking after this deal. The Cartel will remember the favor.
We understand this batch is difficult to prepare. We will postpone the deal and wait to hear from you.
[Cartel commission] The deadline has passed. The representative will contact you again after a week.
It is not this order's delivery day yet.
Deliver forty portions of laboratory-pure dream dust.
I would like to leave the organization, but keep doing business.
We can take your name off the roster and deal as independent partners. Are you certain?
Then it is settled. Your name stays in the ledger. We will keep trading, without the organization's obligations.
I will stay with the organization.
I have another laboratory-pure batch for you.
There is no qualifying extra stock on the counter. Let us settle here for this week.
We will take this batch. Your payment is settled. See you next week.
That is all for this week.
The District 13 Cartel has noticed your business. A contact will visit tomorrow.
The retired chemist said your shop was worth a visit. One question: business partners, or one of us?
Someone vouches for your work. Thirteen minutes ago we were strangers; now I have a long-term proposition. Will you join the Cartel?
Our ledger can list your shop, or your name. One means prices; the other means obligations. Which will it be?
Fine. Your name stays off the roster. Our buyers will still call, and I will check in on Mondays. Good deliveries earn a thank-you; if you are short, we will try next week.
